summary: 1675 is a single-player sailing and coastal trading game set in the seventeenth-century Mediterranean. Players begin aboard a lateen-rigged llaüt and progress towards larger vessels. The game combines physics-based sailing, wind and weather with real geography and bathymetry, historically reconstructed ports, rescue assignments and local reputation. It features first- and third-person perspectives and free conversation in Spanish. The game is in development, with a target release in 2028.
